thread.title: Spotify Stock Gets Price-Target Hikes Ahead Of Earnings Report

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Spotify Stock Gets Price-Target Hikes Ahead Of Earnings Report
text:
Streaming music leader Spotify Technology ( SPOT ) received a pair of bullish Wall Street reports on Friday, just days before it is scheduled to release second-quarter results.
X Buckingham Research on Friday reiterated its buy rating on Spotify stock and raised its price target to 201 from 195. Raymond James kept its strong buy rating on Spotify and upped its price target to 210 from 190.
Raymond James analyst Justin Patterson is bullish on streaming music in general. On Friday, he also raised his price target on Pandora Media ( P ) to 11 from 9 and stuck with his strong buy rating.
"The streaming music industry is still in the early innings of global adoption," he said in a report to clients. "We continue to view the industry as being driven by 1) expansion into new territories, 2) share gains within market, and 3) proliferation of connected speakers and cars (e.g. new engagement channels)."

The recent IPO hit an all-time high of 189.97 on July 12. The Stockholm-based company went public on April 3, starting at 165.90.
Spotify Stock: Results Due Spotify is scheduled to post June-quarter results before the opening bell on Thursday. Analysts expect the company to lose 68 cents a share on sales of $1.27 billion. Key metrics to watch will be subscriber growth and average revenue per user.
Spotify added 4 million new paying subscribers to its premium on-demand music service in the March quarter. That brought its total to 75 million worldwide, in line with analyst expectations. But discount subscriptions through family and student plans reduced its average revenue per user.
Spotify and Pandora compete with Alphabet ( GOOGL ), Amazon ( AMZN ), Apple ( AAPL ) and others in the streaming music business.
